text.p: When you think of V8 juice, you think tomato, right? V8, made by Campbell Soup Co., has introduced V8 Splash, beverages combining fruits such as pineapple, kiwi, lime and mango with carrot juice.
Campbell said that V8 Splash marks the introduction of V8's first non-tomato-based beverage. An eight-ounce serving provides 100 percent of recommended daily value of vitamins A and C.
The product will be available nationally this summer in supermarkets and convenience stores.

The beverages come in three flavors -- Tropical Blend, Strawberry Kiwi and Cirtus Blend. They are available in 16-ounce glass bottles (suggested retail price 99 cents) and 46-ounce plastic bottles ($2.39).
Lever 2000, a product of Unilever Group's Lever Brothers, has introduced Lever 2000 Pure Rain soap.
The scented deodorant soap also has skin moisturizers and is designed for use by both adults and children.

Available nationwide in grocery, mass merchandise, drug and club stores, Lever 2000 Pure Rain comes in two-, six- and eight-bar packs at the suggested retail price of $1.79, $4.29 and $5.39, respectively.

Just in time for July 4th decorations, Fiskars has introduced a new Paper Punch, a tool for children ages five and up. Paper Punch comes in 13 shapes, including circles, triangles, hearts, teddy bears and cats.
It can be used to punch shapes in a variety of materials including cards, paper, self-adhesive labels, gift wrap, stationery, ribbons and confetti.
Each punch has a suggested retail price of $8. For more information, contact Fiskars in Wausau, Wisc. at 715-845-3802.

A set of programmes on child safety, used by schools, social service and law enforcement agencies, is now available for home viewing. "What Tadoo" is a series of tapes that teaches young children the skills they need to stay safe from potentially harmful strangers.

Developed with advice by child abuse experts and produced by J. Gary Mitchell Film Co., the three 20-minute programmes contained on one video use puppet frogs "What" and "Tadoo" to convey important information.

The video is aimed at children ages 4 to 9 and provides non-threatening discussions of potentially dangerous situations. It advises children how to distinguish "good" secrets from bad, and to follow basic rules for getting help.
The video costs $19.95 and can be ordered by calling 1-800-301-4050.
Norsk Hydro, a Norwegian company, is introducing in the United States Odorlos, an environmentally safe product that eliminates foul odours from holding tanks in outdoor toilets, RVs and boats.
Odorlos is a concentrated sanitary liquid that speeds up the natural composting process by providing nitrate as an energy source. It contains no formaldehyde.
A four-ounce bottle costs about $2.75. Other sizes range in price from $7.50 to $19.50.
It is currently available in selected retail outlets. To order call Camping World at 1-800-993-2212 or Boater's World at 1-800-826-2628.
We all buckle up (right?) when we get into the car. What about pets? Dogloo Inc. of Corona, Calif., has developed a pet carrier that features seat belt clips.
A lap belt fits under clips on top of the carrier and keeps it properly secured.
The "Lil' Furrarri" and "Innovator" models have quick release latches for fast and easy assembly, dual door locks and four-sided ventilation.
Both models are available in two sizes. The smaller models weighs 3.5 pounds and the larger weighs 5 pounds. Retail prices range from $17.95 to $29.95.
For more information, call Dogloo at 1-800-326-7387.
